{{Quote|Enter the bureaucrats.|Palpatine|<ref name="TPM" />}}
'''Mas Amedda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] who served as the [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the administrations of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellors]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Amedda served during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and continued to serve under the self-proclaimed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine as one of the first members of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]].

==Biography==
===Early career===
{{Quote|Order! We shall have order!|Mas Amedda|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
A [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] hailing from [[Champala/Legends|Champala]], Mas Amedda was appointed by the Champalan government to represent the watery world in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. As a [[Senator/Legends|senator]], Amedda considered himself an honest politician and strove to voice the wants and needs of his people in the Senate. Addicted to procedure and a stickler for rules, Amedda's fellow members of the [[Rim Faction/Legends|Rim faction]], specifically Senator [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], were anxious to put him in the position of [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chancellor]]. Despite Amedda's allegiance to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], Taa and his followers successfully appointed Amedda to the seat made available by the departing [[Unidentified Bothan vice chancellor|Bothan Vice Chancellor]]; the conspiring Senators hoped to bog down [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] in meaningless procedural squabbles and eventually end his career.<ref name="COD" /> Amedda was also working closely with Senator Palpatine of Naboo to ensure Valorum became powerless, and is one of the few who knew that the Senator of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] was more than he appeared to be.<ref name="Characters">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Placed into office on the heels of the failed [[Eriadu Trade Summit|trade summit]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], Amedda was awarded unprecedented power over the Supreme Chancellor, capable of blocking his ability to call sessions of Congress as well as working with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. As the Chancellor was further weakened by a scandal involving money laundering, support of Valorum's policies in the Senate degenerated, which effectively paralyzed the Chancellor's government. Unknown to the masses of the Republic, Senator Palpatine and the infamous [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] leader of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], were behind the problems bogging down the Chancellor. Indeed even Amedda was a puppet to Palpatine, who was in fact a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="SWDP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> While Palpatine almost had Amedda eliminated for his accelerated climb to power, the Sith Lord decided the Chagrian would better suit the Sith [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]] as Vice Chancellor.<ref name="Hasbro">''[[Hasbro, Inc.|Hasbro]] Power of the Jedi''</ref>

===Brewing conflict===
[[File:Chagrian-AA.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Mas Amedda in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Rotunda]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].]]
Per the Sith Grand Plan that clandestinely controlled every function of galactic politics, Amedda presided over the motion of a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in Valorum's leadership, as requested by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] following Senate inaction in response to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] arm of the Trade Federation. While driven by ambition, Amedda was not foolhardy enough to believe that he could attain the Chancellorship; instead the Chagrian was prepared to manipulate the future Chancellor in order to aid the galactic populace.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Following Senator Palpatine's [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|election]] to the Chancellorship Amedda continued to serve as Vice Chair, planning on manipulating the Naboo man for the betterment of the galaxy. Feeding his ideas to the Chancellor, Amedda believed that he was the true power in the Senate as the Chancellor seemed to play off of his suggestions. In an attempt to keep Palpatine content, Amedda, a connoisseur of rare art, would travel to ancient worlds and obtain precious relics for the Chancellor's collection.<ref name="DB" />

Shortly after the loss of the [[Outbound Flight]] project, Palpatine revealed to Amedda that he was, in fact, the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious. Initially crushed by this revelation, the Vice Chancellor was persuaded to believe in Sidious's vision for a [[Galactic Empire|New Order]] and pledged his loyalty to the Sith Lord. Among Amedda's first duties as a willing pawn of the Sith was to plan the assassination of his former friend Finis Valorum. He also hunted for Sith relics on worlds such as [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Barely Tolerable">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-3|series=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref>

Despite Amedda's attempts to keep procedure his office was constantly bombarded by accusations of scandal. Believed to continuously accept bribes from organizations such as the Trade Federation, Amedda disputed the claims and retained his position without cries for a recall. When the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] threatened to tear the Republic asunder, Amedda continued to attempt to manipulate events in the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]]. As the threat of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] continued to grow, the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] was hotly debated in the Senate Chamber; should the Senate vote to overturn the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] and establish an army or should they continue attempts to negotiate. Upon the discovery of a [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] on the dusty world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], Amedda conspired to persuade the unwitting [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], to propose to give emergency powers to the Chancellor. Unknown to the Vice Chair, the idea was in fact the Chancellor's own, and Palpatine had merely planted the idea in the Chagrian's mind.<ref name="TCWCG" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|You can't keep them reined in, obviously, so we will.|Mas Amedda to [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]|<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>}}
Per Amedda's unsubtle suggestion, Representative Binks convinced the Senate to grant Palpatine emergency powers, and the Supreme Chancellor's first act was to create a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. An army of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] discovered by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] served the role, and the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began.<ref name="Episode 2" /> Retaining his post throughout the conflict, Amedda eventually came to know the truth of Chancellor Palpatine and his alter-ego, Darth Sidious. Believing that the Sith could bring order back to the galaxy, Amedda agreed to keep the secret and planned to do nothing as Palpatine drove the galaxy into turmoil and the Jedi Order in disarray. As Palpatine gauged Amedda's trustworthiness, the Sith Lord ordered his Vice Chair to plan the assassination of former Chancellor Valorum.<ref name="TCWCG" />

During a session of the wartime Senate, Amedda presided over the chamber as the Senators debated the potential threat that the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization posed to the people of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Despite the protests of Mandalore's [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], the Senate was prepared to vote to allow the Republic to occupy the planet in order to resist the Death Watch. Amedda placed a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] into a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] that displayed a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Mandalore's [[Deputy Minister/Legends|Deputy Minister]] [[Jerec/Legends|Jerec]] calling for Republic assistance, though the message had in fact been doctored. Kryze was later [[Plot to assassinate Satine Kryze/Legends|attacked]], and after being granted an audience with Palpatine, was told by Amedda and the Supreme Chancellor that the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt proved that Mandalore needed the Republic's aid. Amedda expressed his belief that Kryze was unable to keep the Death Watch reigned in by herself. When Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of Naboo uncovered Minister Jerec's actual holorecording, requesting that the Republic leave Mandalore alone, Amedda and Palpatine presided over a Senate session that rescinded the Senate's earlier vote to occupy the planet. Kryze, Kenobi, the Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Amidala later discussed the outcome of the vote with Amedda and Palpatine in the Supreme Chancellor's [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office]], and the latter three discussed the logistics of ratifying the Senate's vote.<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore" />

[[File:PalpandMas-DoM.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Amedda and Palpatine preside over the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars.]]

The Vice Chancellor attended Palpatine when the Supreme Chancellor welcomed Skywalker, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and the giant [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to Coruscant; Palpatine was eager to study the beast's fearsome armor despite the Jedi's discomfort with keeping the beast on the capital. Palpatine assigned [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]] to the task of study, and brought Amedda with him to check on her progress. Back in the Supreme Chancellor's office, Skywalker and Amidala appealed Palpatine's decision to kill the creature, but Amedda expressed his opinion that uncovering the secrets to its armor was for the greater good.<ref name="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref> Some time later, Amedda and Palpatine presided over a session that saw Amidala present a [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|bill]] proposing the cutting of [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] spending, and soon after attended the [[Funeral of Onaconda Farr/Legends|funeral]] of Amidala's ally in the Senate, [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], who had been [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] by his aide [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]]. Amidala's bill was voted down, and Amedda was present outside of the Senate Chamber when Palpatine and Amidala discussed the outcome.<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>

Later in the Clone Wars, Amedda accompanied the Supreme Chancellor to Naboo to celebrate the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]]. During the festival, Palpatine was the victim of a kidnapping attempt by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="Crisis on Naboo">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>

At one point<ref name="TCW:Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Maul">''[[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Death Sentence]]'' places the [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] revival arc in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]</ref> Amedda was summoned to Palpatine's office and was asked to prepare him his [[Eta-class shuttle/Legends|shuttle]].<ref name="TCW:Lawless" /> Around that time, Amedda was present at a [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims/Legends|funeral]] for Jedi who were killed in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing]].<ref name="TCW:TJWKTM">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> Soon after, he served a role in the [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|trial]] of the Jedi Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Amedda handed the jury's verdict to Palpatine, but before it could be read, Anakin Skywalker arrived with the true culprit, Barriss Offee.<ref name="TCW:TWJ">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>

As the Clone Wars grew to a new height, Amedda came under scrutiny by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Having obtained knowledge that the mysterious Darth Sidious was tied in with the Chancellor's Office and in control of the entire Senate, Councilor [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] came to suspect Amedda of being the "[[Second Sith theory|Second Sith]]."<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> Before further investigation could commence, Palpatine himself revealed his true persona to Windu and killed him, along with several other members of the High Council.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

Seeing the Grand Plan to fruition, Chancellor Palpatine [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|destroyed]] the Jedi Order and recreated the Republic as the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Attending the [[declaration of a New Order]], Amedda was attending to his new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] when Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] attempted to assassinate Palpatine in the Senate Chamber. Fleeing as the two Force-wielders [[Skirmish in the Senate|dueled]], Amedda returned to the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] following the conclusion of the vicious battle. Assisting Palpatine, the Vice Chancellor oversaw the [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|Emperor's shock troopers]]' search for Yoda. Communicating with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kagi/Legends|Kagi]] and ordering him to prepare the Emperor's [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] for departure to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], Amedda prepared himself for the transition from his former duties to the new ones laid out by the Emperor.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Imperial agent===
[[File:PestageMas.jpg|thumb|left|155px|Mas Amedda attending to the Emperor alongside [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]]]]
Following the Empire's formation, Amedda became one of the first members of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]]. Despite losing his title of Vice Chair, Amedda retained a position of power, acting as Palpatine's representative in the Senate. As his position soon became largely irrelevant, Amedda was relegated to reclaiming lost [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] from worlds previously quarantined by the Jedi Order. Despite this apparent demotion, Amedda enjoyed his ability to pursue his thirst for knowledge of Sith history, exploring many Sith worlds. During this time, Amedda ventured to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]; discovering rare [[Piranha beetle/Legends|piranha beetles]] which delighted the Emperor.<ref name="I92">[[Star Wars Insider 92|''Star Wars Insider'' 92]]</ref> He later retreated to a secret Imperial citadel on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], Palpatine's secret throne world, where he proceeded to outline plans necessary for the New Order for the next 10,000 years and beyond.<ref name="Barely Tolerable" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mas Amedda was played by [[Jerome Blake]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']], [[David Bowers]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], and by both Blake and Bowers in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']].

He appeared in the episodes "[[Duchess of Mandalore]]," "[[Senate Murders]]," "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," "[[Pursuit of Peace]]" and "[[The Zillo Beast Strikes Back]]" of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. He was voiced by [[Stephen Stanton]].

Amedda appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars Episode I'': The Phantom Menace video game]], released in [[1999]], during the game's sixth mission, ''Danger in Coruscant.'' The mission contradicted the movie and this article assumes it is non-canon. Amedda met with [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Captain Panaka]] on a landing platform on Coruscant. He was escorting Queen Amidala to safety, following attacks by mercenaries paid by the Trade Federation. Amedda offered to sell his two [[Coruscant City Tours|Coruscant City Tour]] tickets to him for 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic credits]] each (half of what he originally paid) because he had business to attend to on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Panaka tried to barter for them with a pair of [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]], however Amedda declined, on account of having no use for them. He suggested Panaka sell the electrobinoculars to someone else to get the money. When Panaka returned with the 100 credits, Amedda asked for 200 credits to be paid. Panaka then brought this mistake to Amedda's attention, and Amedda apologetically gave him the tickets. In [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]], he was identified only as a citizen.

Amedda's name is misspelled in ''[[Jedi Quest: The School of Fear]]'' as "'''Ameeda'''."
